title: Morphisms from the spectrum of a local ring (Stacks 01J6)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $B$ a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$; let $z$ be the closed point $\mathfrak n$ of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. (a) The germ map $\varepsilon_B:B=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}B,\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}B})\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}B,z}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is an isomorphism of rings. (b) For a morphism of schemes $f:\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ put $x_f=f(z)$ and $\varphi_f=\varepsilon_B^{-1}\circ f^\sharp_z:\mathcal O_{X,x_f}\to B$, where $f^\sharp_z:\mathcal O_{X,f(z)}\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}B,z}$ is the local homomorphism induced by $f$ on stalks [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Then $\varphi_f$ is a local homomorphism of local rings, and $f\mapsto(x_f,\varphi_f)$ is a bijection from the set of morphisms of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ onto the set of pairs $(x,\varphi)$ consisting of a point $x\in X$ and a local homomorphism of local rings $\varphi:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to B$.
